transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m just imagining it. But I know what I see. My wife’s relative came into this house to get at me. Look, my tools don’t just move themselves. I know exactly where I leave them. And my fishing plans... they don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. It's been happening for months now, and I can see plain as day that he’s been trying to take over my place and push me out.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

No. No, I don't hear any voices. It's... I'm not hearing things that aren't there. I'm just talking about what I can actually see happening right in front of me with my own two eyes. But voices? No, nothing like that.
Has anything happened that you believe would be impossible for ordinary people to do?

No, nothing impossible. I mean... what do you mean by impossible? Like magic or something? No, it's nothing like that. 

He's just a regular guy doing sneaky stuff. Anybody can pick a lock or slip through a window if they really want to. He just waits until I'm out of the house, and then he comes in and messes with my things. There's nothing impossible about it, it's just plain old trespassing to get under my skin.
Have you been feeling unusually high or energized lately?

No, I haven't. I just feel like myself. I mean, I'm frustrated and stressed out because of everything going on with my house and my things, but I don't feel unusually high or anything like that. Just... normal energy, I guess. I still go to work at the plant, do my job, come home. I'm just tired of dealing with him sneaking around.
Have you had any recent head injury?
No, I haven't hit my head or anything. No accidents, no falls. My head is perfectly fine. I just... I just want this guy to stop breaking in, that's all.
Have you found yourself losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, not really. I still enjoy the things I always have. I mean... I still watch the game on weekends, tinker around in the garage, stuff like that. It's a little harder to fully relax right now with the house stuff on my mind, sure, but my interests haven't changed. I still like doing what I usually do.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?

No, nobody's said anything like that to me. I talk just like I always have. I mean, I stick to the point. When I try to explain what's happening at my house, I lay it out plain and simple. I don't jump around or anything. People understand me just fine.
Have you noticed yourself becoming less expressive or emotionally flat compared with how you used to be?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. I feel things just the same as I always have. I mean, if I'm angry about this guy messing with my house, I get angry. If I'm happy, I smile. I'm not... flat, or whatever you called it. I'm just a regular guy dealing with a really stressful situation, that's all.
How long has this been going on?
About nine months. Yeah, it's been going on for about nine months now. It all started right around the time my wife's relative moved into our house.
